reward_contract.chance_credit: bounded symmetric potential of accumulated same/adjacent-tick lethal probability; retained on every outcome
reward_contract.description: Every KO wins +100 and loses -100 regardless of combo or remaining food; simultaneous KO 0, timeout -30. Bounded +/-20 chance potential and up to +5 useful direct-damage pressure. Missed normal-attack opportunities cost .02 plus .005 per miss in the last 20 ticks, never reset by attacking. No cost during normal cooldowns; eating on a ready tick has its real opportunity cost. No HP/eating/cast reward or forced action. Chance remains conditional on recorded one/two-tick events with healing, Vengeance and recoil.

stable_v1_reference.label: stable v1 migrated by explicit feature/action names

improvement_evidence.interpretation: Proven KO-score improvement, or proven chance improvement with score CI lower bound at least .48; current score at least .5. No supported current chance or varied chance/score regression. Useful direct damage/tick at least 90% of reference, deliberate ready waits at most 8% of all decision ticks, no head-to-head timeouts, and stable-v1 score at least .5. Combo type never gates qualification. No automatic promotion.

selection.metric: lexicographic: actor mean KO/chance/pressure objectiveReturn, then KO score; all KOs equal; ties retain earlier snapshot
